messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — planning to roll SDK v3.2.1 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Scope: minor telemetry fix + safer header parsing. No new public surface, but we want to be conservative.
Samir Khan: I can own the deploy and smoke run. What's the target canary percent? :thinking_face:
Maya Patel: Thanks Samir. Start with 5% global, hold for 15m, then 25% for 15m, then full. If any errors >0.5% or latency spike >200ms, rollback immediately.
Jordana Lee: I'll run the compatibility quick-check against client bindings (python/node). Plan: run the local integration suite at 08:00 PT and post results here.
Leo Chen: Patch LGTM. I pushed a shim to avoid <Content-Length> parsing issues — shouldn't affect older clients. Verified with unit tests.
QA Bot: automated-tests: integration: 48 passed, 2 flaky (filed #INF-432), e2e: 12 passed, smoke: pending
Ben Torres: @Maya who is on-call for rollback during the window? Need a direct contact in case we cut smoke early.
Ops Alice: I'll be the rollback owner. Rollback plan: revert deployment tag to v3.2.0, scale pods to previous replica count, clear ingress cache. Command: `kubectl set image deploy/sdk-proxy sdk-proxy=registry/redwood/sdk:v3.2.0 -n prod` — validate with `kubectl rollout status`.
Samir Khan: I'll keep a watch on metrics and run the smoke script every 5m. Smoke script: `scripts/smoke_top_level.sh --endpoint https://api.redwood.ai --key $SMOKE_KEY`
Jordana Lee: Quick question — do we need a special client-compat flag for older SDKs? I tested 2.x and 3.1 and didn't see breaking behavior, but want confirmation.
Maya Patel: No runtime flag needed. We're preserving wire contract. But please check header-encoding edge-case in the 2.x adapters — if anything suspicious call rollback.
Leo Chen: Also will enable verbose request logging on canary for 1 hour so we can audit any weird decodes. Logs go to project sdk-canary-logs.
Ben Torres: Draft customer note for client-facing comms (for the SDK repo release): "Patch release v3.2.1: minor bugfix and telemetry improvements. No breaking changes. Please upgrade when convenient." Want legal and docs eyes, @Jordana @Maya.
Jordana Lee: Fine to ship that. I'll add a short migration note about header parsing and include the compat test link.
Maya Patel: Timeline recap: 08:00 PT — final integration smoke (Jordana). 09:00 PT — deploy to 5% (Samir). 09:15 PT — expand to 25% if healthy. 09:30 PT — full rollout if green. Ops Alice is rollback owner and will announce if rollback occurs. Everyone pls be reachable 08:45–10:00 PT. :alarm_clock:
QA Bot: reminder: set ephemeral credentials for smoke key. Token expires in 6h.
Samir Khan: Ping me in thread at 08:55 and i'll start the canary. I'll post `deploy-id` and `image` when kicked off.
Maya Patel: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll pin the rollout checklist and client note link to the thread. :thumbsup:
Leo Chen: +1 — good to go from infra side.
Ben Torres: +1 from comms.
Jordana Lee: +1 from QA
